entries.title: I Corinthians 6:1
segments: Can it be that, when one of you has a dispute with another, he dares to have his case tried before the heathen, instead of before Christ's People?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:2
segments: Do not you know that Christ's People will try the world? And if the world is to be tried by you, are you unfit to try the most trivial cases?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:3
segments: Do not you know that we are to try angels-to say nothing of the affairs of this life?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:4
segments: Why, then, if you have cases relating to the affairs of this life, do you set to try them men who carry no weight with the Church? To your shame I ask it.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:5
segments: Can it be that there is not one man among you wise enough to decide between two of his Brothers?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:6
segments: Must Brother go to law with Brother, and that, too, before unbelievers?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:7
segments: To begin with, it is undoubtedly a loss to you to have lawsuits with one another. Why not rather let yourselves be wronged? Why not rather let yourselves be cheated?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:8
segments: Instead of this, you wrong and cheat others yourselves-yes, even your Brothers!

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:9
segments: Do not you know that wrong-doers will have no share in God's Kingdom? Do not be deceived. No one who is immoral, or an idolater, or an adulterer, or licentious, or a sodomite,

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:10
segments: Or a thief, or covetous, or a drunkard, or abusive, or grasping, will have any share in God's Kingdom.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:11
segments: Such some of you used to be; but you washed yourselves clean. You became Christ's People! you were pronounced righteous through the Name of our Lord Jesus Christ, and through the Spirit of our God!

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:12
segments: Everything is allowable for me! Yes, but everything is not profitable. Everything is allowable for me! Yes, but for my part, I will not let myself be enslaved by anything.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:13
segments: Food exists for the stomach, and the stomach for food; but God will put an end to both the one and the other. The body, however, exists, not for immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body;

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:14
segments: And, as God has raised the Lord, so he will raise up us also by the exercise of his power.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:15
segments: Do not you know that your bodies are Christ's members? Am I, then, to take the members that belong to the Christ and make them the members of a prostitute? Heaven forbid!

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:16
segments: Or do not you know that a man who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body (for 'the two,' it is said, 'will become one');

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:17
segments: While a man who is united with the Lord is one with him in spirit?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:18
segments: Shun all immorality. Every other sin that men commit is something outside the body; but an immoral man sins against his own body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:19
segments: Again, do not you know that your body is a shrine of the Holy Spirit that is within you-the Spirit which you have from God?

entries.title: I Corinthians 6:20
segments: Moreover, you are not your own masters; you were bought, and the price was paid. Therefore, honor God in your bodies.
